import json, subprocess, sys
CAND='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def run(reqs):
    data='\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+'\n'
    out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in out.stdout.splitlines()]

def flow(fid, path, kinds='QTKKKKKK', tmpl=None, H=8):
    return dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl or ('00'*H),kinds=kinds)

def hdr(fid_tmpl, H=8, q=0, t=200):
    b=bytearray(bytes.fromhex(fid_tmpl))
    b[0]=q; b[1]=t
    return bytes(b).hex()

# tie: f0 benefit 20 (count 2), f1 benefit 10, f2 benefit 10 -> prefer single flow f0
caps={'a':1,'b':1}
flows=[flow('f0',['a','b']),flow('f1',['a','b']),flow('f2',['a','b'])]
offers={'f0':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=2)],
        'f1':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=1)],
        'f2':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=1)]}
r1=dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=[],offers=offers)
# zero benefit flow should not be selected
offers2={'f0':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=0 if False else 1)],'f1':[],'f2':[]}
r2=dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=[],offers=offers2)
# pinned zero benefit must be selected
r3=dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=['f1'],offers=offers2)
# tie where two 10s beat nothing: capacity 1 per node -> only one flow can be chosen
r4=dict(mode='plan',capacities={'a':1,'b':1},flows=[flow('f1',['a','b']),flow('f2',['a','b'])],warmup=0,pinned=[],
        offers={'f1':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=1)],'f2':[dict(header=hdr('00'*8),count=1)]})
res=run([r1,r2,r3,r4])
print('tie/one-big :', res[0], 'expect saved=20*?')
print('zero-benefit:', res[1])
print('pinned-zero :', res[2])
print('equal-tie   :', res[3])
PYEOF
